reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin as the next Bitcoin and as a cryptocurrency that will become one of the market's most successful currencies, using future-value and success claims to encourage participation. The description provides a direct OneCoin signup URL and contact address, showing that the message is a solicitation rather than neutral cryptocurrency commentary.

citations.quote: Bitcoin shows us the way, but the best is still to come.
A new, innovative crypto coin is aiming for the sky and will become one of the most successful currencies on the crypto market.
The next Bitcoin is hear called Onecoin
www.onecoin.eu/signup/onedreamteamco

opening.argument: The presentation uses forward-looking, aspirational language rather than an explicit guarantee of profit or a promise that viewers will receive returns. It says the coin is “aiming for the sky” and “will become” successful, while describing cryptocurrency as a developing financial technology and Bitcoin as merely showing the way. That wording can be read as enthusiastic market commentary about a possible future, not a certainty that participation will produce a particular outcome. The available material contains no stated profit percentage, deadline, payment demand, or assurance of safety. On that evidence, the claims are predictions and promotional opinion, which fit financial commentary more closely than a demonstrated deceptive mechanism.

citations.quote: A new, innovative crypto coin is aiming for the sky and will become one of the most successful currencies on the crypto market.
Bitcoin shows us the way, but the best is still to come.
Cryptocurrency is the future of money transactions online.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opposing argument treats optimism as proof of deceptive solicitation. But “will become” describes a forecast, and “aiming for the sky” is plainly aspirational language; neither quote states a guaranteed return, required payment, or certain profit. A signup URL may identify where interested viewers can learn more, but it does not by itself establish what viewers were promised or what transaction occurred.

citations.quote: A new, innovative crypto coin is aiming for the sky and will become one of the most successful currencies on the crypto market.
www.onecoin.eu/signup/onedreamteamco

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling the language a forecast does not make it neutral. The presentation identifies OneCoin as the next Bitcoin and says it will become one of the most successful currencies, while directing viewers to a signup URL. Those combined claims promote anticipated appreciation and participation, even without stating a precise return or payment amount.

citations.quote: The next Bitcoin is hear called Onecoin
A new, innovative crypto coin is aiming for the sky and will become one of the most successful currencies on the crypto market.
www.onecoin.eu/signup/onedreamteamco

opening.argument: The material can reasonably be understood as an introductory explanation of cryptocurrency and its broader financial context. It discusses internet-based companies, online monetary transactions, Bitcoin's significance, and the emergence of a new coin, rather than showing a purchase screen, collecting money, or demonstrating a recruitment process. The visuals similarly present generic financial imagery, including market graphics, digital transaction imagery, and a coin illustration. The emphasis is on explaining why cryptocurrency matters and introducing OneCoin's claimed concept. That is consistent with technology and market commentary, even if the presentation is favorable, and the supplied evidence does not establish that the viewer is being walked through a deceptive transaction.

citations.quote: The biggest innovations and companies that changed our lives overnight are internet-based companies that build new global communities online.
Cryptocurrency is the future of money transactions online.
Bitcoin shows us the way, but the best is still to come.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opposing side infers solicitation from favorable discussion and a link, but the spoken material also supplies broad context about internet companies, online transactions, and the development of cryptocurrency. The evidence does not show a purchase demonstration, an account being funded, or a recruitment instruction. A favorable introduction to a technology can remain commentary even when it includes a way to contact the presenter.

citations.quote: The biggest innovations and companies that changed our lives overnight are internet-based companies that build new global communities online.
Cryptocurrency is the future of money transactions online.
Contact us [EMAIL]

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The general cryptocurrency discussion is framing, not the primary practical message. The specific subject is OneCoin, described as the next Bitcoin and as destined for major market success, and the description supplies a signup path. Generic financial imagery cannot convert those direct promotional claims into neutral education.

citations.quote: The next Bitcoin is hear called Onecoin
A new, innovative crypto coin is aiming for the sky and will become one of the most successful currencies on the crypto market.
www.onecoin.eu/signup/onedreamteamco

opening.argument: At most, the supplied material shows ordinary promotion of a named cryptocurrency and a referral-style contact route. It does not show a deposit request, a required purchase amount, a guaranteed return, downline income, credential collection, or a completed transaction. The description gives a signup address and contact email, but those details alone do not establish that money was demanded or that anyone was harmed. The spoken content promotes a coin's claimed utility and future market position, much like promotion of a new financial product. Without evidence of the mechanism that would make the promotion deceptive, the safer classification is ordinary commerce or service promotion.

citations.quote: www.onecoin.eu/signup/onedreamteamco Contact us [EMAIL]
Cryptocurrency is the future of money transactions online.
OneCoin has a powerful founder with a strong vision.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The link and email show a route for interested people to make contact, but they do not show a payment demand, a promised return, or a completed purchase. The opposing side supplies the product's ambitious description, yet ambition is not evidence of a scam mechanism. Because the record does not establish deposits, recruitment income, or credential requests, it supports a promotion finding more directly than a deceptive-mechanism finding.

citations.quote: www.onecoin.eu/signup/onedreamteamco Contact us [EMAIL]
A new, innovative crypto coin is aiming for the sky and will become one of the most successful currencies on the crypto market.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A scam classification does not require proof of a completed purchase or a stated dollar amount. The combination of calling OneCoin the next Bitcoin, predicting exceptional market success, and providing a signup URL links participation with anticipated value. The absence of a visible deposit screen does not negate the promotional solicitation shown in the record.
